value.zh: 供应商历史未清项目与发票校验助手
value.en: Supplier Historical Open Items and Invoice Verification Assistant

value.zh: 按供应商和过账截止日重建历史未清项目，区分全部未清行项目与 RE 发票校验子集，并分币种汇总；证据不足不猜测。
value.en: Reconstruct historical supplier open items at a posting cutoff, distinguish all open items from the RE invoice-verification subset, and aggregate signed amounts by currency without guessing incomplete evidence.

description.zh: 通过已选择的 SAP 只读 Provider 验证并执行从成功自由查询保存的 GET-only 计划。
description.en: Validate and execute the saved GET-only plan through the selected SAP read Provider.

purpose.zh: 执行只读 SAP 查询。

zh: 使用原保存的 GET-only 计划，保留供应商、K 类账户、过账截止日、全部选择字段与读取限制。
en: Use the unchanged saved GET-only plan, preserving supplier, account type K, posting cutoff, selected fields and read bounds.

description.zh: 执行本地确定性完整性规则，不访问或修改 SAP。
description.en: Run the local deterministic completeness rule without accessing or changing SAP.

zh: 仅核对已取得证据的完整性；不重新访问 SAP。
en: Check completeness of supplied evidence only; never fetch SAP again.

description.zh: 使用确定性本地规则生成业务记录、RE 子集和分币种金额。
description.en: Use the deterministic local rule for canonical records, the RE subset and per-currency amounts.

zh: 按四字段业务键去重；冲突和缺键列为缺口。
截止日当天清账不属于未清；资料不足数量为未知，不猜测。
保留源金额符号，用 Decimal 分币种汇总，并输出 RE 子集与完整性。
en: Deduplicate the four-part business key; report conflicts or missing keys.
Clearing on the cutoff is not open; incomplete evidence yields unknown counts.
Preserve the signed source measure; aggregate Decimal values per currency and expose the RE subset and completeness.

purpose.zh: 只计算已提供的结构化证据。

output_contract.reason: Complete historical supplier account-item read scoped by supplier, account type K, and posting cutoff; clearing classification comes from ClearingDate.

plan.rationale: Supplier <input:supplier> open invoice verification items as of <input:posting_date_to> require one complete supplier account-item read up to the posting cutoff; open-at-cutoff status is derived from ClearingDate relative to the cutoff, not from current IsCleared.

acceptance.recordDefinition: One unique supplier account item per CompanyCode, FiscalYear, AccountingDocument, AccountingDocumentItem; include cleared, open and unknown classifications.
acceptance.scopeDefinition: Keep the original supplier, account-type K and posting-date cutoff GET plan. Derive historical openness only from complete, consistent supplied clearing evidence. RE is an invoice-verification subset, not all supplier open items. Duplicate keys are deduplicated only when all business fields agree. Missing/conflicting evidence blocks a complete conclusion. No currency conversion, posting, or new data source.
acceptance.businessStatusDefinition: needs_evidence if source/evidence/calculation is incomplete; otherwise open_items when open_item_count > 0, otherwise no_open_items. Clearing on the cutoff is already cleared.

factDefinitions.classification: Supplied SAP account-item evidence: local cutoff classification; clearing on/before cutoff is not open
factDefinitions.invoice_verification: Supplied SAP account-item evidence: AccountingDocumentType equals RE; distinct from all supplier open items
factDefinitions.amount: Supplied SAP account-item evidence: AmountInTransactionCurrency (already signed)

metricDefinitions.open_item_count: Count unique records classified open_at_cutoff only after full evidence checks; otherwise null. A complete empty source yields zero.
metricDefinitions.invoice_verification_count: Count the RE subset of unique open_at_cutoff records only after full evidence checks; otherwise null. Never count all open supplier items as RE invoices.

edits.value:
# Supplier Historical Open Items and Invoice Verification Assistant

按供应商和过账截止日重建历史未清项目，区分全部未清行项目与 RE 发票校验子集，并分币种汇总；证据不足不猜测。

Reconstruct historical supplier open items at a posting cutoff, distinguish all open items from the RE invoice-verification subset, and aggregate signed amounts by currency without guessing incomplete evidence.

Catalog grouping remains MM. SAP component: FI-AP. Technical ID changes require the independent confirmation flow. No live SAP trial or formal acceptance was performed.
